Our mission


## Solve the unique challenges of frontline work with truly intelligent AI

80% of the global workforce doesn't work at a desk, yet the tools that serve them are running on outdated technology. Sona changes that with an end-to-end platform unifying Scheduling, HR, Payroll and Engagement — replacing legacy systems and weaving intelligent AI throughout.

Our values


## What drives us every day

01


### AI Everywhere

We are AI-first in how we think and work. Every team member actively explores how AI can transform what we do, not just speed it up.


02


### Relentless

We take full ownership of outcomes and never stop solving the next problem. If something can be better, we make it better, whether it's in our remit or not.


03


### Speed

We move fast, back ourselves, and act today rather than waiting for certainty. We focus on the size of the outcome, not the ways things can fail.


04


### Curious

Deep knowledge of our product, our customers, and our craft is what sets us apart. We're never satisfied with what we knew yesterday.


05


### Sports team

We play to win together, hold each other to the highest standards, and give honest feedback with good intentions. No politics, no passengers.


Benefits


## How we work at Sona

We believe everyone does their best work when they are happy and feel in control. That's why we measure in output, not time.

Share options

All permanent employees are granted share options. You'll receive detailed info in your offer letter and a Capdesk account to track your options.


Pension contribution (up to 5%)

We'll enroll you in a salary sacrifice pension and match any contributions you make up to 5% of your base salary.


Comprehensive health insurance

In eligible countries, we offer 'medical history disregarded' health insurance via Bupa to all of our team, as a taxable benefit.


Extra holiday day every year

Start with 25 days plus 10 flexible public holidays, and get 1 extra day for every year you stay with Sona.


Professional development budget

Quarterly £200 budget for courses, conferences, books, and learning new skills — technical or otherwise.


Home office equipment budget

New starter budget of £600 and a supplementary annual budget of £300 to deck out your setup. Plus, a new MacBook when you start with the appropriate spec for your role.


Enhanced parental leave and pay

Primary parent and carer leave: 26 weeks full pay. Paternity and secondary parent leave: 8 weeks full pay.


Hybrid working

We have offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon.


Regular team retreats

Once per year, the whole team comes together for a week of workshops and fun — preferably somewhere sunny.
